description:
Get a specific time-tracking by ID from Holded.

Args:
  - time_id (string): The time-tracking ID to retrieve (required)
  - response_format ('json' | 'markdown'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  Time-tracking details including employee, time, and status.

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data or 'markdown' for human-readable

name: holded_team_get_time_tracking
title: Get Holded Time Tracking
